{{Quote|The Alliance has decided that it is time to try to make a strike at the Outer Rim. We believe that the Empire is stretched too thin to adequately defend all of its positions in these systems. Our first goal is to take Kessel.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Willham Burke]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
A space '''battle''' took place in the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the culmination of an attempt of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]'s [[Fourth Battle Group (Rebel Alliance)|Fourth Battle Group]] to take control of [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
